subject: Catalyze Medical — AWS private-offer staging & procurement roadmap
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara.singh@catalyzemed.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Nov 2029 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Catalyze Medical — AWS private-offer staging & procurement roadmap

Hi Tara —

Great to meet last week. As discussed, I put together a short staging roadmap that aligns the AWS private-offer (Marketplace) procurement steps with the evaluation milestones Catalyze wants to hit. The goal: make the PO + invoice path clear to avoid surprises for procurement and finance.

High-level (preview):
- Week 1: Sandbox onboarding + test dataset run (Dev/QA access)
- Week 2-3: Acceptance tests (integration + latency/perf checks)
- Week 4: Sign private-offer PO in AWS; billing route queued to your Finance contact (Net30 or ACH as agreed)
- Post-sign: Dedicated onboarding + SLO handoff (monitoring + cost controls)

I'm attaching a draft mutual action plan (MAP) with explicit owners and a recommended billing path that mirrors what other healthcare customers have used to expedite approval. Can you confirm: (1) who on your procurement team will own the PO; (2) preferred billing cadence (Net30 vs Net45); and (3) any internal acceptance gates we should account for?

If it's helpful, we can schedule a quick working session with your procurement and finance folks tomorrow afternoon to walk the MAP.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0197

Attachment: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (MAP; owners, milestones, acceptance criteria)
Attachment: aws-private-offer-terms.pdf (private-offer summary)

From: Tara Singh <tara.singh@catalyzemed.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Mohammed Ali <m.ali@catalyzemed.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@catalyzemed.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Nov 2029 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Catalyze Medical — AWS private-offer staging & procurement roadmap

Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the documents. High level sounds good. Quick answers:
1) Procurement contact: Mohammed Ali (cc'd) will own the PO.
2) Preferred billing: Net30 is standard for us, but Finance sometimes asks for ACH details for faster processing.
3) Acceptance gates: We need a security checklist completed (SOC2 evidence + encryption key handling), and a short performance acceptance test (TPS/latency) signed off by our SRE lead.

Can we do the working session tomorrow at 2pm PT? Mohammed will join. Also — please send any SOC2 artifacts or where they live.

Best,
Tara
VP Product | Catalyze Medical
tara.singh@catalyzemed.com

> Attachment note: redwood-map looked good on first pass.

Subject: Re: Catalyze Medical — AWS private-offer staging & procurement roadmap

Tara / Mohammed —

Thanks — 2pm PT tomorrow works. I've pulled together the SOC2 reference pack and a short acceptance test script for your SRE team. Karthik (cc) will handle contract / billing paths and can confirm the most common routing for AWS private-offer invoices (we route to your procurement email; finance receives consolidated invoice). Laura (CS) and Grace (Solutions) will support the sandbox and acceptance tests.

Quick notes so we go into the session with clear outcomes:
- Karthik: confirm whether Redwood will accept Net30 on AWS private-offers via consolidated invoice or if Catalyze needs a vendor-side invoice per AWS's marketplace flow. If consolidated invoice is preferred, we'll include billing metadata for your finance team.
- Security: SOC2 pack link included below (read-only S3). We'll provide redacted encryption key handling docs for procurement review.
- Acceptance tests: short perf script (5 sample requests, 10k tokens) + success criteria (average 95th pct latency < 350ms; correctness pass rate > 95%)

I've attached an updated MAP that maps these items to owners and adds a suggested approval timeline to keep to a 4-week close.

See you tomorrow.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-map-v1.xlsx (updated), aws-private-offer-terms.pdf
Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/678901/catalyze-med-DL-2029-1178 , https://s3.redwood-inference.com/soc2/catalyze-pack-readonly

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Nov 2029 14:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Catalyze Medical — AWS private-offer staging & procurement roadmap

Hi Mohammed / team —

Quick procurement note from Redwood finance side: we can support two billing patterns for AWS private-offers:
1) Marketplace consolidated invoice: Redwood aggregates charges and sends a monthly invoice to Catalyze Finance (preferred for most customers).
2) Direct AWS charges with vendor attribution: charges flow through your AWS invoice; procurement often prefers this when internal cloud chargeback is important.

For Net30 we are happy to proceed. To accelerate approval, please confirm: (A) billing contact and AP email (for invoice routing); (B) any PO number format requirements; and (C) whether Catalyze requires Redwood to complete any vendor onboarding forms (W9, PO setup).

Procurement checklist (suggested for the MAP session):
- Confirm billing cadence & AP email (owner: Catalyze Finance)
- PO issuance and AWS private-offer linking (owner: Mohammed)
- Vendor onboarding docs returned (owner: Catalyze Procurement)
- Security artifacts validated (owner: Redwood & Catalyze Security)
- Acceptance tests scheduled and pass (owner: Catalyze SRE / Redwood Solutions)

I'll prepare a short DocuSign envelope for the private-offer T&Cs once we finalize billing path. Sharing a sample DocuSign link below so your procurement team can see the flow.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — good working session today. Actionable items confirmed:
- Mohammed will issue PO by 11/20 and include our internal PO prefix CATALYZE-11-2029.
- Finance (ap@catalyzemed.com) confirmed Net30; we will accept consolidated Redwood invoice.
- Security: Karthik — we received the SOC2 pack link; Catalyze Security will validate by 11/18 and send any follow-ups.
- Acceptance tests: Laura/Grace to kick off sandbox access tomorrow; SRE will run the perf script and aim to finish by 11/19.
- DocuSign: Karthik to send the T&Cs envelope once PO path is final.

Please send the sample invoice template and any vendor form PDFs to procurement@catalyzemed.com. Looking forward to closing this cleanly — target close date remains 11/22 to allow time for invoice setup.

Best,
Tara
